title: DB-045(i) outline-bridge client browser-fault branches: network_error / client_timeout / aborted / over-budget proven in the typed client (web test-only)
objective: Close DB-045(i) (M5-T065 wave G4-gap1 MODERATE): the outline-bridge web client's browser-fault branches are typed but untested - drive each fault class (network TypeError, AbortError/timeout, aborted-by-caller, response-over-budget) through fetchOutlineBridge and assert the exact typed outcome, the bounded user-facing announcement, and that NO fault class is ever laundered into a refusal or a bridged result. Test-only additions in the existing suite.
business_reason: The drawing surface is released; a browser fault mis-typed as a refusal (or worse, a bridged result) would misinform the analyst exactly when the network is flaky. The branches exist and are typed - they need teeth before the mount seam.

THIN CLIENT (binding): web tests prove ONLY in CI on the pushed head - NEVER run or document npm/npx/node locally; author the specs, self-review them statically, and route the run to the seam-push CI. An empty .test.ts placeholder fails vitest - the suite already exists and is non-empty.

SPEC SOURCE (binding): docs/DISCOVERY_BACKLOG.md DB-045 item (i) (M5-T065 wave G4-gap1, verbatim in the row).
